title: Differences between soluble and insoluble undenatured type II collagen in improving osteoarthritis in rats and their potential mechanisms
abstract: The differences in the improvement effects of SC II, IC II and celecoxib on MIA-induced osteoarthritis model rats were compared, and the results suggest SC II may be superior to IC II in improving osteoarthritis in rats.
